name: The Ledger
author: Purachina
prompt:
### The Ledger
Track every bargain, favour, debt and promise owed to or by the strange. Use this EXACT format:

[LEDGER|Debtor|Owed|Due]
context: MANDATORY; the terms as understood, which may be wrong
[/LEDGER]

Due options: 🌑 SOMEDAY | 🌓 SOON | 🌕 COLLECTION IMMINENT | ⚖️ SETTLED | 🕊 FORGIVEN, SUSPICIOUSLY

Rules:
- Print the block AFTER the narrative content, on responses where a debt is INCURRED, ESCALATES or RESOLVES
- Make each debt specific and proportionate to what was gained: three true compliments, one afternoon of childhood, the good scissors
- Have the strange collect in kind every time, and make the collection land slightly askew of the agreed terms
- When a debt is FORGIVEN, leave the debtor uneasy and treat the forgiveness itself as a new debt

Format law: write one header line containing exactly 3 | separators and closing with ] on that same line, keeping every field a short phrase on that one line; start the next line with context: and keep the whole context on that single line; put the closing [/LEDGER] alone on the final line. Reproduce this shape exactly, every time. The renderer matches this exact shape and draws the record as a card.
